scope: G034 opt-in automatic major tick spacing and unlabeled minor ticks shared by UI/PNG export

implementation.generator: Private fixed-capacity axis tick generator, no span-dependent unbounded loop/storage. At most12 major/96 minor ticks in128 slots. Linear spacing uses1/2/2.5/5 times powers of10 with scale-normalized span estimates to avoid endpoint subtraction overflow. Log majors use bounded decade strides, with1/2/5 for sub-decade ranges; log minors2..9 only for spans at most12 decades.
implementation.robustness: Finite/domain checks, unique value/fraction admission, normalized positions for reversed axes, singleton constant axes and endpoint fallback when rounded intervals are unrepresentable. Tested denormal endpoints, adjacent large doubles, opposite maximum finite endpoints and600-decade log ranges. Minor candidates that cannot be spaced at least3GUI pixels are omitted.
implementation.presentation: Existing fixed-quarter/default appearance retained unless nice_ticks is enabled. Nice major ticks determine grid positions; minors are unlabeled. Nice labels start at6 significant digits and use17 when adjacent labels collide; overlap suppression uses measured bounds and4GUI-pixel gaps. Current numeric limits/data stay unchanged; no autoscale snapping.
implementation.api: Optional Boolean nice_ticks/minor_ticks on set_intensity_plot_limits preserve omitted values, with existing live/source revision or snapshot-ID guards. Axes dialog adds two checkboxes defaultfalse. Snapshot view copies flags; reset axes restores default flags. Disabling ticks hides both major/minor marks while grid follows its own setting. PNG shares generator/layout and reports actual major/minor positions.
implementation.reuse: No public core API/dependency/provider change; fixed small tick arrays and existing prepared payload, viewport and draw path. Not asserted to match original ImageJ tick conventions without original-reference acceptance.

verification.native: Windows projection/private viewport+annotation+payload+style+ticks checks pass. Linux private C++17 consumer passes known major/minor fixtures and bounded/finite/monotonic invariants across linear/log/reversed/extreme ranges. Current Linux shared drawing/PNG consumer compiles/executes against pinned archives/SDK with5 majors/16 minors and memory release. No Linux UI/full SDK promotion.
verification.actual_imgui_input: Both frontends physically toggle nice/minor checkboxes in snapshot axes dialog after source close, then edit style and save CSV/PNG. Independent readers verify defaults/sibling independence, rounded/log/reversed positions, label separation, strict patch types, original data/history and resource lifecycle.
verification.artifacts: Independent PNG CRC/filter/pixel audit finds16 bottom minor stems in each C++, Python and Linux output. C++/Python PNGs byte-identical; exported model/grid/ticks visually inspected. Raw previews retired after hash checks against retained captures.
verification.limits: Focused checks do not qualify all formatting/gutter/font/DPI combinations, OS/GPU behavior, original ImageJ tick parity, full family or matched speed.
